final_text.golden: The curated table's answer here is stale — it points at qwen2.5-coder:14b, which is two generations old and actually a downgrade from the qwen3:14b the role runs today. Qwen4-Coder shipped in June in two sizes. The 30B-A3B scores highest at 68.4% on SWE-bench Verified but needs ~18.5GB of VRAM and will not fit your 16GB card. Qwen4-Coder-7B is the one to use: 54.1%, ~5.2GB, and it still beats qwen2.5-coder:14b (40.2%) at half the memory. Neither is in the curated table — worth adding the row in Settings → Models (ollama:qwen4-coder:7b, ~5.2GB VRAM, coder role) and verifying with the test probe.
